```plato
//==
// # Remeshing
//
// Changing a mesh's TRIANGULATION rather than its shape: refining it, coarsening
// it, regularizing it, and smoothing it. The types the passes hand each other are
// declared in `remeshing.types.plato`, whose header states the one design decision
// everything here follows — every operation is a whole-mesh REBUILD driven by
// decisions taken against a single unchanging input, never an in-place edit.
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Triangle corners
//  - Derived triangle connectivity
//  - Vertex remaps
//  - Welding
//  - Edge split
//  - Edge collapse
//  - Edge flip
//  - Loop and Butterfly subdivision
//  - Catmull-Clark and Doo-Sabin subdivision
//  - The subdivision scheme driver
//  - Smoothing
//  - Quadric error metrics
//  - Quadric decimation
//  - Isotropic remeshing
//
// COST. Nothing in this vocabulary has a keyed container (see LINT013 on `IMap`),
// so an edge table is recovered by scanning corners against corners: building
// `TriangleMeshTopology` is quadratic in the corner count, and that build is the
// price of admission for every pass below. Treat a few thousand triangles as the
// working range and read the per-function notes before sizing an input.

library Remeshing
{
    //==
    // # Triangle corners
    //
    // A triangle mesh's corners are numbered exactly as `CornerTable`
    // (`topology.types.plato`) numbers them: corner c belongs to triangle c / 3 at
    // slot c mod 3. A corner also READS as the directed edge leaving its own
    // vertex for the next corner's vertex, which is what lets the connectivity
    // below be recovered without storing a half-edge record per side.

    // The triangle a corner belongs to: corners come three per face, in face order.
    CornerFace(corner: CornerIndex): FaceIndex
        => FaceIndex(corner.Value / 3);

    // The slot a corner occupies within its own triangle: 0, 1 or 2.
    CornerSlot(corner: CornerIndex): Integer
        => corner.Value % 3;

    // The next corner counter-clockwise around the same triangle, wrapping from
    // slot 2 back to slot 0.
    NextCorner(corner: CornerIndex): CornerIndex
        => CornerIndex(corner.Value - corner.Value % 3 + (corner.Value + 1) % 3);

    // The previous corner around the same triangle: two steps forward of three.
    PreviousCorner(corner: CornerIndex): CornerIndex
        => NextCorner(NextCorner(corner));

    // The total number of face corners: three per triangle.
    CornerCount(self: TriangleMesh3D): Integer
        => self.Faces.Count * 3;

    // The vertex sitting at a corner. Precondition: the corner is in
    // [0, CornerCount).
    CornerVertex(self: TriangleMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): VertexIndex
        => self.Faces[corner.Value / 3][corner.Value % 3];

    // The position at a corner.
    CornerPosition(self: TriangleMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): Point3D
        => self.Positions[self.CornerVertex(corner).Value];

    // The vertex a corner points AT, reading the corner as a directed edge.
    CornerDestination(self: TriangleMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): VertexIndex
        => self.CornerVertex(NextCorner(corner));

    // The corner running the opposite way along the same undirected edge, found by
    // scanning every corner for the one whose directed edge is this one reversed.
    // Returns the "none" index on a boundary edge. Linear in the corner count, so
    // the whole twin table below is quadratic.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Typed indices (-1 means "none").
    TwinCorner(self: TriangleMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): CornerIndex
    {
        var from = self.CornerVertex(corner);
        var to = self.CornerDestination(corner);
        return CornerIndex(self.CornerCount
            .MapRange(c => CornerIndex(c))
            .Reduce(-1, (found, other) =>
                self.CornerVertex(other).Equals(to).And(self.CornerDestination(other).Equals(from))
                    ? other.Value
                    : found));
    }

    // The two endpoints ordered A.Value <= B.Value, matching the canonical form
    // `UndirectedEdgeList` (`topology.types.plato`) stores.
    CanonicalPair(a: VertexIndex, b: VertexIndex): VertexPair
        => a.Value <= b.Value ? VertexPair(a, b) : VertexPair(b, a);

    // True when either endpoint of an undirected edge is the given vertex number.
    PairTouches(pair: VertexPair, vertex: Integer): Boolean
        => (pair.A.Value == vertex).Or(pair.B.Value == vertex);

    // The endpoint of an undirected edge that is not the given vertex number.
    // Precondition: the vertex is one of the two endpoints.
    PairOtherEnd(pair: VertexPair, vertex: Integer): VertexIndex
        => pair.A.Value == vertex ? pair.B : pair.A;

    //==
    // # Derived triangle connectivity
    //
    // Recovering `TriangleMeshTopology` from a bare `TriangleMesh3D`. This is the
    // step a mutable remesher does once and then maintains incrementally; here it
    // is done once per pass and thrown away, which is what removes the incremental
    // bookkeeping from every algorithm below.
    //
    // An undirected edge is a twin pair of corners named by the lower of the two
    // (a boundary corner names its own edge), and its number is the RANK of that
    // naming corner among all naming corners — the same canonical-corner rule
    // `meshes-polygon.library.plato` uses for `PolygonMesh3D`.
    //
    // Cost: quadratic in the corner count, and it dominates every pass built on it.

    // The twin of every corner, in corner order.
    CornerTwinTable(self: TriangleMesh3D): Array<CornerIndex>
        => self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => self.TwinCorner(CornerIndex(c)));

    // True when corner c names its undirected edge: it has no twin, or it is the
    // lower half of the twin pair.
    NamesItsEdge(twins: Array<CornerIndex>, c: Integer): Boolean
        => twins[c].IsNone.Or(c < twins[c].Value);

    // The full derived connectivity of a triangle mesh. Every pass below starts
    // here, and a caller running several passes should build this once and pass it
    // down rather than let each pass rebuild it.
    TopologyOf(self: TriangleMesh3D): TriangleMeshTopology
    {
        var twins = self.CornerTwinTable;
        var n = twins.Count;
        var naming = n.MapRange(c => NamesItsEdge(twins, c));
        var rank = n.MapRange(c =>
            c.MapRange(d => naming[d] ? 1 : 0).Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit));
        var cornerEdges = n.MapRange(c =>
            UndirectedEdgeIndex(naming[c] ? rank[c] : rank[twins[c].Value]));
        var edgeCorners = n.MapRange(c => c).Reduce(Repeat(0, CornerIndex(0)),
            (acc, c) => naming[c] ? acc.Append(CornerIndex(c)) : acc);
        return (cornerEdges,
                twins,
                edgeCorners.Map(c => CanonicalPair(self.CornerVertex(c), self.CornerDestination(c))),
                edgeCorners);
    }

    // The number of deduplicated undirected edges the topology found.
    EdgeCount(self: TriangleMeshTopology): Integer
        => self.UndirectedEdges.Count;

    // The two endpoints of an undirected edge, canonically ordered.
    EdgeEndpoints(self: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): VertexPair
        => self.UndirectedEdges[edge.Value];
```
